title: Hampi
subtitle: Ancient Ruins · Stone Chariot · UNESCO World Heritage
inclusions: Mumbai to Mumbai SL Class Train Tickets

itinerary.title: Train Journey — Mumbai to Hosapete
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Panvel Station. Reporting Time: 10:30 AM. Board train for Hosapete. Overnight journey. 12 November 2026 (Thursday).

itinerary.title: Reach Hosapete & Travel to Hampi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Hosapete by 6:00 AM. Travel to Hampi by bus (30 min). En-route breakfast. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. Evening at leisure. Dinner at hotel. 13 November 2026 (Friday).

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing — Day 1
itinerary.description:
Breakfast. Out for sightseeing. Dinner at hotel. 14 November 2026 (Saturday).

Sightseeing places: Underground Shiva Temple, Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stable, Queen's Bath Complex, Nandi (Monolithic).

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing — Day 2
itinerary.description:
Breakfast. Out for sightseeing. Dinner at hotel. 15 November 2026 (Sunday).

Sightseeing places: Kondaram Temple, Sugreev Caves, King's Balance, Stone Chariot, Vijay Vitthal Temple, Coracle Ride.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at 8 AM. Visit Virupaksha Temple, Kadalekalu Ganesha, Sasivekalu Ganesha, Badavalinga Temple. Travel to Hosapete Station. Board train for Mumbai. 16 November 2026 (Monday).

Reach Mumbai by 10:45 AM. Return home with sweet memories!
